audit.whatIsWrong: Chart handed Vayne levels 2-3 and the first-item window, which contradicts both the packet chart and the prose, and it never showed the real shape of the lane: K'Sante owns 2 through 6, Vayne owns two items onward.
audit.why: Vayne is immobile and squishy until attack speed; K'Sante's Path Maker wall-stun plus the Ntofo Strikes shockwave beats her while Condemn is on 20s at rank 1. Two items in, Silver Bolts' true damage voids his armour.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill / K'Sante / K'Sante / K'Sante / K'Sante / Skill / Vayne, matching the packet and the 49.95% win rate over 935 games.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes gave no cooldowns and described Vayne's scaling only as 'her W'.
audit.why: Tumble is 6/5/4/3/2s and gets shorter under Final Hour; Condemn is 20/18/16/14/12s; Silver Bolts procs on the third consecutive attack or ability against the same target. Those numbers set when each side's window opens.
audit.corrected: Spikes now carry Tumble's 6s, Condemn's 20s, and the third-hit true-damage condition.

audit.whatIsWrong: The text repeatedly called K'Sante's second Ntofo stack a 'Q3 knock-up'. It is a shockwave that pulls enemies in — the knock-back and stun come from Path Maker (W). Condemn was described only as a peel, never as a terrain stun, and Tumble's auto-attack reset was absent.
audit.why: Riot's Q text: 'At 2 stacks, K'Sante fires a shockwave that pulls enemies in.' Riot's Condemn text: if the target collides with terrain they are impaled, taking bonus damage and being stunned — so standing next to a wall is what makes her E lethal, not the knock-back itself. Tumble carries the autoReset flag, so her burst opens on an attack wind-up.
audit.corrected: Q2 is now a pull, W is the stun; Condemn's terrain stun is stated with the instruction to fight away from walls; the Tumble wind-up is named as the tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every content-layer string was written in the first person ('I just farm', 'my bulk', 'she out-scales me').
audit.why: The site's voice is second person; the first-person block reads as a different champion page.
audit.corrected: whys, early, mid and late rewritten in second person at the same length.

edits.before: Vayne is one of the safest level 1s into me but she's also fragile and immobile until she gets attack speed, so I just farm with Q at level 1 and don't feed her free tumble resets. The instant I hit Level 3 I have my real threat: W Path Maker charged into a wall is a long stun, and if I catch her tumbling toward terrain I follow with Q3 to knock her up and pull her in. Bait her E condemn before I commit my W charge — if she burns condemn to peel an early step-up, my next all-in lands clean.
edits.after: Vayne has one of the safest level 1s into you, but she is fragile and immobile until attack speed, so farm with Q and give her no free Tumble resets. At Level 3 you get the real threat: Path Maker (W) charged into a wall is a long stun, and the 2-stack Ntofo Strikes shockwave pulls her back in behind it. Watch her auto wind-up, not the cast — Tumble is an attack reset. Bait Condemn (E), 20s at rank 1, before you commit the W charge.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 are mine: she has to walk up to last-hit and my Q out-pokes her tumble poke while my bulk eats her early autos. At 6 All Out is my best window all game — it gives me the dash range to chase through her Q invis and the duelist damage to actually kill her before Silver Bolts ramp. The trick is her E: she will condemn me into a wall to cancel my engage, so I want to W through the stun or save my E Footwork to re-stick after she tumbles. Every fight I win here is a fight her items haven't happened yet.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 are yours: she has to walk up to last-hit and your Q on 3.5s out-pokes Tumble while your bulk eats her early autos. At 6 All Out is your best window all game — the dash range chases her Tumble and the duelist damage kills her before Silver Bolts ramp. The trick is Condemn: it knocks you back, and only stuns if you hit terrain, so start the fight off the wall and keep Footwork (E) to re-stick after she tumbles. Every fight you win here is one her items have not happened for yet.

edits.before: This is where it flips and I have to be honest about it: once Vayne has Botrk and Shieldbow, her W Silver Bolts deal percent-max-HP true damage every third hit, so all the armor my passive and items stack does literally nothing against her. She kites my short Q and my W charge with tumble and condemn, and in a long fight she out-DPSes me even through R's duelist stats. My only late plan is to not duel her — use R All Out to peel her OFF my carries and pull her into my team, never to 1v1. If the game went this long I lost my windows; close it on the earlier spikes.
edits.after: This is where it flips: once Vayne has Botrk and Shieldbow, Silver Bolts deals percent-max-HP true damage on every third consecutive hit, so the armour your passive and items stack does nothing against her. She kites your 450-range Q and your W charge with Tumble and Condemn, and in a long fight she out-DPSes you even through All Out's duelist stats. Your late plan is not to duel her — use R to launch her through a wall, off your carries and into your team, never to 1v1. If the game got here you missed your windows; close it on the earlier spikes.
